macros.name: pgfkeysactivatefamilies
macros.doc: Activates each family in ⟨family list⟩ and creates a macro ⟨deactivate macro name⟩ which deactivates each family in ⟨family list⟩.

macros.name: pgfkeysactivatefamiliesandfilteroptions
macros.doc: A simple shortcut macro which activates any family in the comma separated {⟨family list⟩}, invokes \pgfkeysfiltered⟨key–value-list⟩ and deactivates the families afterwards.

macros.name: pgfkeysactivatefamily
macros.doc: Equivalent to \pgfkeys{⟨family name⟩/.activate family}.

macros.name: pgfkeysactivatesinglefamilyandfilteroptions
macros.doc: A shortcut macro which activates a single family and invokes \pgfkeysfiltered.

macros.name: pgfkeysalso
macros.doc: This command has exactly the same effect as \pgfkeys, only the default path is not modified before or after the keys are being set.

macros.name: pgfkeysalsofiltered
macros.doc: This command works as \pgfkeysfiltered, but it does not change the current default path.

macros.name: pgfkeysalsofilteredfrom
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfkeysalsofiltered which loads its key list from {⟨macro⟩}.

macros.name: pgfkeysalsofrom
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfkeysalso which loads its key list from {⟨macro⟩}.

macros.name: pgfkeyscurrentname
macros.doc: The ⟨name⟩ of ⟨key⟩ (everything after the last slash) is stored in the macro \pgfkeyscurrentname.

macros.name: pgfkeyscurrentpath
macros.doc: The ⟨path⟩ of ⟨key⟩ (everything before the last slash) is stored in the macro \pgfkeyscurrentpath.

macros.name: pgfkeysdeactivatefamily
macros.doc: Equivalent to \pgfkeys{⟨family name⟩/.deactivate family}.

macros.name: pgfkeysdef
macros.doc: This command temporarily defines a TeX-macro with the argument list #1\pgfeov and then lets ⟨key⟩/.@cmd be equal to this macro.

macros.name: pgfkeysdefargs
macros.doc: This command works like \pgfkeysdefnargs, but it allows you to provide an arbitrary ⟨argument pattern⟩ rather than just a number of arguments.

macros.name: pgfkeysdefnargs
macros.doc: This command works like \pgfkeysdef, but it allows you to provide an arbitrary ⟨argument count⟩ between 0 and 9 (inclusive).

macros.name: pgfkeysdetokenizedvalueof
macros.doc: This is the same as \pgfkeysvalueof, but the result will be wrapped inside \detokenize.

macros.name: pgfkeysevalkeyfilterwith
macros.doc: Evaluates a fully qualified key filter ⟨full key⟩ with argument(s) ⟨filter arguments⟩.

macros.name: pgfkeysfiltered
macros.doc: Processes all options in exactly the same way as \pgfkeys{⟨key–value-list⟩}, but a key filter is considered as soon as key identification is complete.

macros.name: pgfkeysgetfamily
macros.doc: Returns the family associated to a ⟨full key⟩ into macro ⟨resultmacro⟩.

macros.name: pgfkeysgetvalue
macros.doc: Retrieves the tokens stored in the ⟨full key⟩ and lets ⟨macro⟩ be equal to these tokens.

macros.name: pgfkeysifdefined
macros.doc: Checks whether this key was previously set using either \pgfkeyssetvalue or \pgfkeyslet.

macros.name: pgfkeysifempty
macros.doc: Tests whether the value stored in ⟨full key⟩ is empty.

macros.name: pgfkeysiffamilydefined
macros.doc: Checks whether the full key ⟨family⟩ is a family and executes either ⟨true case⟩ or ⟨false case⟩.

macros.name: pgfkeysinstallkeyfilter
macros.doc: The command \pgfkeysinstallkeyfilter{⟨full key⟩}{⟨optional arguments⟩} has the same effect as \pgfkeys{⟨full key⟩/.install key filter={⟨optional arguments⟩}}.

macros.name: pgfkeysinstallkeyfilterhandler
macros.doc: The command \pgfkeysinstallkeyfilterhandler{⟨full key⟩}{⟨optional arguments⟩} has the same effect as \pgfkeys{⟨full key⟩/.install key filter handler={⟨optional arguments⟩}}.

macros.name: pgfkeysisfamilyactive
macros.doc: Sets the TeX-boolean \ifpgfkeysfiltercontinue to whether ⟨family⟩ is active or not.

macros.name: pgfkeyssavekeyfilterstateto
macros.doc: Creates {⟨macro⟩} which contains commands to re-activate the current key filter and key filter handler.

macros.name: pgfkeyssetfamily
macros.doc: The command \pgfkeyssetfamily{⟨full key⟩}{⟨family⟩} has the same effect as \pgfkeys{⟨full key⟩/.belongs to family={⟨family⟩}}.

macros.name: pgfkeyssetvalue
macros.doc: Stores the ⟨token text⟩ in the ⟨full key⟩.

macros.name: pgfkeysunexpandedvalueof
macros.doc: This is the same as \pgfkeysvalueof, but the result will be wrapped inside \unexpanded.

macros.name: pgfkeysvalueof
macros.doc: Inserts the value stored in ⟨full key⟩ at the current position into the text.

macros.name: pgfqkeys
macros.doc: This command has the same effect as \pgfkeys{⟨default path⟩/.cd,⟨key list⟩}, it is only marginally quicker.

macros.name: pgfqkeysalso
macros.doc: This command has the same effect as \pgfkeysalso{⟨default path⟩/.cd,⟨key list⟩}, it is only quicker.

macros.name: pgfqkeysfiltered
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfkeysfiltered which uses the ‘quick’ search path setting.
